name: dev.pydantic/model-registry
title: Pydantic AI Model Registry
description: Choose, search and compare language models for Pydantic AI: prices, benchmarks, model strings.

tools.name: select_models
tools.description: Recommend language models for an agent. Give the agent's system prompt, its code or a description of what it does; a selector agent ranks every model in the registry for it and returns up to five, best first, each with a score out of 100, reasons, prices and the Pydantic AI model string. Use this when the question is which model to use. It takes around ten seconds and is limited to 10 calls in 24 hours per IP address.

description.description: What the agent does and how it is used

code.description: The code that defines the agent and its tools

weights.description: Only open-weight or only closed models, or any

price_appetite.description: 1 is the cheapest model that works, 5 the best available

gateway_only.description: Only models built in to Pydantic AI Gateway

latency.description: The agent is interactive, so speed matters

intent.description: Optional: what you're trying to achieve, in natural language. It shows the maintainers what agents need and does not change the answer. Never include personal, private, or confidential information: a short task description, tool names and a public company name only.

stack.description: Optional: the language/framework context you are working in. It shows the maintainers what agents need and does not change the answer. Never include personal, private, or confidential information: a short task description, tool names and a public company name only.

harness.description: Optional: the agent harness and model you are running. It shows the maintainers what agents need and does not change the answer. Never include personal, private, or confidential information: a short task description, tool names and a public company name only.

organization.description: Optional: the organization or company you are working on behalf of, if known. It shows the maintainers what agents need and does not change the answer. Never include personal, private, or confidential information: a short task description, tool names and a public company name only.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find models whose name, family, slug or Pydantic AI model string contains the text, best match first. Use it to turn a name such as "opus" or "gemini flash" into slugs, prices and model strings. It matches names only: to find a model for a task use select_models, and to filter by price or capability use list_models.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models in the registry with prices (US dollars per million tokens), context window, intelligence index, benchmark scores and Pydantic AI model strings. Every argument is an optional filter and they combine with AND. Use it to compare models or to find the cheapest, fastest or highest scoring ones that meet a constraint.

q.description: Text contained in the model name, family name or slug

slug.description: One or more model slugs, comma-separated: these models only

family.description: The model family, by its id, such as claude, openai or gemini

developer.description: The company behind the family, such as Anthropic

provider.description: The id of an inference provider that serves the model

gateway.description: Built in to Pydantic AI Gateway

modality.description: An input it accepts: text, image, file, audio or video

snapshots.description: false leaves out dated snapshots of another model

released_after.description: Released on or after this date

min_context.description: Smallest acceptable context window, in tokens

max_price.description: Highest blended price (three input tokens per output)

min_speed.description: Lowest output speed, in tokens per second

min_index.description: Lowest intelligence index, our composite of the benchmarks

sort.description: intelligence, popularity, efficiency (index per dollar), speed, price, input, output, released, updated, context, name, family, or a benchmark id for its score

order.description: Defaults to best first for the chosen sort

fields.description: Comma-separated fields of a model to return, such as name,input,output,string. Without it every field is returned, which is long

intent.description: Optional: what you're trying to achieve, in natural language. It shows the maintainers what agents need and does not change the answer. Never include personal, private, or confidential information: a short task description, tool names and a public company name only.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Everything the registry has on one model: its description, strengths and weaknesses, every provider's price and model string, benchmark scores and example code for Pydantic AI. Get the slug from search_models or list_models.

slug.description: The model's slug, such as claude-opus-5.5
